evidence: News heading into May 6 is heavily dominated by a sharp macro-driven reversal. Following an initial post-FOMC surge, risk assets plummeted with the Nasdaq falling nearly 5% and Bitcoin tumbling over 7% towards $36,800, marking one of its worst single-day drops of the year due to renewed inflation and rate-hike fears. While counterbalanced by institutional demand signals—most notably Luna Foundation Guard purchasing $1.5 billion in BTC and significant exchange net outflows—the overwhelming negative momentum and correlation with distressed traditional equity markets create a strong bearish bias for the upcoming 24-hour window.
